positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Led development on scheduling platform to help companies find contingent workers.
Responsible for MVP creation and demo at industry conference in 4 month time frame.
Specced out feature work and assignment for a small team.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked at a small startup on embedded software for a DSLR camera
controller. This was an Arduino based system that would primarily be
controlled via the audio port on an iPhone. Designed the circuit as
well as prototype PCB and assisted with production PCB. Prototyped iPhone app to work with device.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Six month co-op position at Thomson.  Worked on a variety of projects and tasks.  Primary responsibility was being the lead developer for an HR web magazine, which included implementing new features and tracking and fixing bugs.
